CASCADE
It does the watching for you

Cascade watches how films move.

Every film travels the same path — announced, into cinemas, out to premium digital, then rental, then streaming. Cascade follows that path for Australia and tells you the moment a film you have been waiting for lands somewhere you can actually watch it.

It is not a search box for what is on tonight. It is a standing watch on the films you mean to see, so you stop finding out six weeks late.

The five windows
  • Upcoming announced, dated, not yet out
  • In cinemas showing on Australian screens
  • Premium early digital, before rental
  • Rental rent or buy at the usual price
  • Streaming included with a service you pay for
Who it is for

People who keep a running list of films they mean to see, and keep missing the moment those films become watchable.

Where it is up to

Cascade is in development.

It covers Australia only, and currently tracks films across cinema and every major Australian streaming, rental and free service.

Where the data comes from

This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. The Movie Database ↗

Powered by Watchmode ↗

Streaming availability by JustWatch ↗

Cascade is not affiliated with any streaming service, and does not play or host video. Watching a film still needs whatever subscription or purchase the service asks for.
